post.description: Calculates TF-IDF cosine similarity, ingredient overlap, dietary filters, rating boosts, and Random Forest suitability to recommend dishes.

Uses the trained RandomForestRegressor to predict a general suitability/quality score [1.0–5.0] for a recipe based on its structural features. Score is NOT user-personalized — it reflects general recipe quality patterns. Returns 3.0 (neutral fallback) if model artifact is unavailable.

get.description: Returns K-Means discovered recipe clusters with auto-generated descriptions.
Returns recipes in the same K-Means cluster as the given recipe.
Returns metadata for all loaded ML models: TF-IDF, RF, K-Means, SentenceTransformer.

post.description: Fetches all recipes from the DB and retrains TF-IDF, Semantic, RF, and K-Means models in the background.

Submit a list of raw ingredient strings and receive structured, normalised ingredient data including quantity, unit, preparation note, category, optional flag, normalization metadata, and parser confidence score.

get.summary: Get Normalised Ingredients for a Recipe
get.description: Retrieve the stored raw ingredient strings for a recipe and return them fully parsed through the Ingredient Intelligence engine, including Phase 5.2 metadata (category, display_name, matched_alias, etc.).

post.description: Takes a list of recipe ingredients with required quantities, matches each against the grocery catalog, and returns per-store basket breakdowns including package counts, line costs, delivery fees, and totals.
Takes a list of recipe ingredients, evaluates three shopping strategies (cheapest single store, cheapest split cart, fastest available), and recommends the most practical shopping plan.

get.description: Retrieve all pantry items for the current user.
